findings.description: When ANSI codes are stripped, the code also calls `.strip()` on the whole prompt text, removing leading and trailing whitespace. Prompts such as `"Name: "` lose their trailing space.
findings.rationale: Trigger: prompt text ends in a space (click builds prompts as `text + suffix`, with the default suffix `": "`) and the stream is not a tty or color is disabled. In that case the stripping branch runs and `.strip()` removes the trailing space, so the user's input is typed directly after the colon (`Name:foo`). It also changes output compared with echo-based prompting, which only strips ANSI. This is visible in CliRunner tests and with piped output.
